top.line: Turning the 49 browser tools of tools.sgraph.ai into sovereign websites, each with its own team.

in-short.line: 49 tools and 90 components, one site each, simple first, components pulled out, pinned versions, signed hashes, a team of teams.

problem.line: Every tool was a problem I had, and an answer to a web buried in ads and hidden features.

map.line: Keys and secrets, vaults and sending, AI and agents, audio and video, documents and images, publishing.

why.line: An explorer project slowed; one site each: own address, documented, good-looking, cheap, forkable, with a team.

ai.line: A small agent in each tool, with models in the browser or on the device where they can run.

waves.line: Wave one simple, already started by the factory; then secrets and vaults, audio and video, AI and agents.

components.line: The tools' components become a versioned library each tool pins.

versions.line: latest/ overwritten at each release, and every release pinned in its own folder with security and architecture.

hashes.line: Signed manifests of file hashes in a separate repository, so a compromised site shows.

teams.line: A tools conductor, family teams, and a team per tool; one brief for a change across many.

limits.line: The sites do not exist yet; the hash scheme is a design; counts as of 19 November.

sources.line: The SGraph-AI__Tools repository and the factory's requests of 19 November.
